benchmark_custody.note: Prospective metadata is not a completed launcher record. Final canonical benchmark/progress custody must use actual supervisor command/times/counters, raw publication and inspected report provenance.

cost_boundary.claims: No timing speedup, calibrated S, matched rho, end-to-end advantage or new target mechanism asserted.
cost_boundary.cold: Each method rebuilds matrix/cancellations, elimination, kernel, identification and certificates for every case. No old C, pivot, kernel, scalar or lifted-weight warm start.
cost_boundary.primitives: Fr add/sub/mul/inv counted separately, with original-row verification and lifting paid. Fp/group calls and inverse pow internals do not provide scalar arithmetic weights.
cost_boundary.shared: Projected rows built once per case; counters separate from method totals. Independent checker diagnostics and inclusive process resources retain separate ownership.
cost_boundary.supplied_rows: Historical collection is not replayed and is not treated as free in an end-to-end interpretation.

limitations: Administrative source/interface readiness, not independent staffed scientific review, primitive-counter audit, verified model/provider or official scientific transition.
576 solver executions are paired calls on 288 dependent row systems in one physical panel; all target slots reuse the same 32 public points.
Counter API coverage excludes integer reductions, sorting/dictionaries, serialization/storage/OS and dense checker internals. Diagnostic shared-host clocks have wall_valid=false.
Full-ledger validation refused the sparse checkout; no full pass is claimed.

limits.resource_route: Existing shared workstation only; no new paid resources or cloud submissions.

parent_provenance.verified: Actual raw gzip content/size matches the pinned main artifact manifest. The public fixture copy equals original input bytes at both named source snapshots.

prospective_protocol.seed_contract: Every solver/instance row has metadata seed 0. All 576 mappings checked; actual export lint positive and ID/seed corruption controls passed.

resolved_findings.control: Tiny fault injection fails only in candidate after a counted Fr subtraction, preserving baseline result/scalar and failed candidate phase/counter.
resolved_findings.initial_defect: A second-arm failure could discard the successful first result because compare returned the pair together.
resolved_findings.resolution: Completed arms emit on_result immediately after public checks; on_failure journals failed/partial phases, available result and error. Driver does not duplicate completion events.
Both arms and shared projection use dedicated ScalarField. Old Field add/sub aggregation is not used for Fr.
